data.name: Dilbag
data.gender_notes: Dilbag is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hindi language, Dilbag translates to 'Heart full of love'. It is a powerful and evocative name for a baby boy, evoking feelings of warmth, compassion, and deep affection. The name Dilbag carries the meaning “Heart full of love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilbag usually hope their child will grow to embody heart full of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilbag total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
